data_qualification: GridMarketDefinition.load() first fits a smooth statically arbitrage-free SANOS surface to each date and evaluates it on the regular grid. This comparison tests the SANOS generative decoder against direct PCA when both use the same cleaned, SANOS-interpolated mid_vols observations; it does not test SANOS preprocessing against raw OptionMetrics interpolation.
dynamic_arbitrage_qualification: Static surface arbitrage and sampled fixed-contract return diagnostics are distinct. Failure to detect a one-sided opportunity in the sampled contracts does not prove absence of arbitrary dynamic arbitrage.

training.return_semantics: spot next-action return plus fixed-contract delta-hedged option return; each option uses its matched expiry or explicitly labelled one-day repricing horizon
training.measure: original physical P; proposal paths carry the complete path likelihood p/q exactly once
training.standard_error_convention: population moments over action dates with independent Monte Carlo paths as clusters; path_clustered_mean_error uses one within-path action-date mean per independent path

payoff_and_break_even_coverage.raw_spot_crossing_definition: same-path option-horizon spot strictly above the fixed cash strike; at expiry this is equivalent to a strictly positive call payoff

validation.return_semantics: spot next-action return plus fixed-contract delta-hedged option return; each option uses its matched expiry or explicitly labelled one-day repricing horizon
validation.measure: original physical P; proposal paths carry the complete path likelihood p/q exactly once
validation.standard_error_convention: population moments over action dates with independent Monte Carlo paths as clusters; path_clustered_mean_error uses one within-path action-date mean per independent path

zero_adverse_single_instrument_policy.definition: At each query state, among directions with zero adverse outcomes in the training-neighbour sample, select the one instrument/direction with the largest estimated favorable part and use unit L1 exposure; otherwise do not trade.

conditional_moment_signal.definition: directional E[dH|z] exceeds g times the population conditional standard deviation estimated from the same uniform k-nearest-neighbour sample

neighbor_radius.metric: Euclidean distance after training-only componentwise standardization
